title: Formulation and Acoustic Modulation of Optically Vaporized Perfluorocarbon Nanodroplets
protocol: Rinse out a 10 mL round-bottom flask with chloroform.
Wash out a 10 µL and 1 mL gas tight glass syringe with chloroform by repeatedly aspirating the full syringe volume and expelling it for a total of three times.
Add 200 µL of DSPE-mPEG2000 (25 mg/mL) to the round-bottom flask using the syringes.
Add 6.3 µL of DSPC (25 mg/mL) to the round-bottom flask using the syringes.
Add 1 mL of IR 1048 (1 mg/mL in chloroform) to the round-bottom flask using the syringes.
Remove the solvent utilizing a rotary evaporator, slowly adjusting the vacuum to 332 mbar.
Reduce the pressure to 42 mbar after 5 min to remove any water that may have entered the solution.
Suspend the lipid cake in 1 mL of phosphate buffered saline (PBS) and sonicate or vortex at room temperature for 5 min or until all of the lipid cake has been suspended and dissolved in the solution.
Sonicate for an additional 2 min to homogenize the solution.
Transfer the solution to a 7 mL glass vial.
Place the glass vial in a glass dish filled with ice.
Rinse out the gas tight glass syringe with perfluorohexane.
Dispense 50 µL of perfluorohexane into the vial using the syringe.
Submerge the probe tip below the meniscus in the glass vial.
Ensure that the sides of the sonicator probe do not touch the lip of the glass vial.
Probe sonicate the mixture with an amplitude of 1, process time of 20 seconds, pulse-on time of 1 second, and pulse-off time of 5 seconds.
Sonicate at an amplitude of 50, process time of 5 seconds, pulse-on time of 1 second, and pulse-off time of 10 seconds.
Transfer the nanodroplet solution to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 3 minutes.
Discard the pellet.
Transfer the supernatant to another 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Wash the supernatant by centrifuging at 3000 x g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the PFCnDs in 1 mL of PBS by pipetting up and down.
Sonicate the resuspended PFCnDs in a bath sonicator for 1 minute.
Measure the size of the droplets using dynamic light scattering (DLS).
Dilute the stock PFCnDs by 100-fold with PBS.
Bath sonicate the diluted solution to disperse the PFCnDs before measuring.
Determine the concentration of PFCnDs using the nanoparticle tracking analyzer.
Dilute the PFCnDs by 100-1000-fold for accurate measurement.
Prepare 10 mL of ultrasound coupling gel in a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 1% (v/v) or 100 µL of PFCnDs to the gel solution.
Vortex the solution to mix thoroughly.
Centrifuge the mixture at 4000 x g for 3 min to remove bubbles.
Degas water by filling a 500 mL vacuum flask with 400 mL of deionized water.
Seal the flask with a rubber cork and connect it to the vacuum line.
Open the vacuum line and submerge the bottom of the flask in the bath sonicator.
Sonicate for 5 min or until no gas bubble formation is visible.
Prepare 10% ammonium persulfate (APS) solution by dissolving 500 mg in 5 mL of degassed water.
Gently swirl the APS solution if it does not fully dissolve.
In a 400 mL beaker with a stir bar, add 150 mL of degassed water and 50 mL of 40% (w/v) acrylamide-bisacrylamide solution to form 200 mL of 10% acrylamide-bisacrylamide solution.
Stir the mixture at 200 rpm without introducing bubbles.
Weigh out 400 mg of silica and add it to the 10% acrylamide-bisacrylamide solution from step 2.3 to form a 0.2 %(w/v) silica and acrylamide solution.
Cut off the tips of a plastic transfer pipette and support it in the mold with lab tape to create a cylindrical inclusion in a square mold measuring 58 mm x 58 mm x 78 mm.
Add 2 mL of 10 % APS solution to the beaker to make a final concentration of 0.1% APS.
Add 250 µL of TEMED to the phantom solution.
Stir the solution briefly (less than a minute).
Pour the solution into the mold carefully, avoiding air bubbles.
Allow the solution to polymerize within 10 minutes.
Remove the phantom by running the flat end of a lab spatula around the edge of the mold and inverting the mold.
Submerge the phantom in water and store at 4°C for reuse.
Turn on and warm up the pulsed laser system for ~20 min following manufacturer instructions.
Ensure that the fiber optical bundle is properly connected to the laser output and the two legs are placed within the fiber bundle holder.
Turn on the ultrasound imaging system.
Connect array imaging transducer to the system.
Fix the transducer within the holder to align its imaging plane with laser cross section.
Set the pulse repetition frequency of the laser system to 10Hz.
Place a powermeter at the end of the fiber bundle to measure energy.
Tune the q-switch delay until the estimated fluence is 70 mJ/cm2.
Backfill one of the channels in the polyacrylamide phantom with the ultrasound gel/PFCnD mixture using a 1 mL plastic slip tip syringe.
Liberally cover the top of the channel with ultrasound gel.
Remove any bubbles with a 1 mL plastic slip tip syringe.
Place the polyacrylamide phantom underneath the transducer and fiber bundle as shown in Figure 3.
Use the combined laser ultrasound and elasticity (CLUE) imaging platform based on the software to image PFCnD synchronized with optical activation.
Change the general user-defined parameters in Param structure for imaging: set start/end depth to 0/40mm, center frequency to 6.9MHz, and transducer name to 'L11-4v'.
Define a new RunCase.

Design a module sequence for repeated optical activation/recondensation and US imaging of PFHnDs by listing predefined modules such as ultrafast imaging (mUF), external laser (mExtLaser) and idle(mIdle).
Repeat the sequence mExtLaser-mIdle-mUF-mExtLaser-mUF twice to acquire both n-pulse and p-pulse imaging data.
Set ExtLaser.Enable to 0 for the first mExtLaser module in each sequence.
Include an 'mIdle' module to minimize time between background US images and the n/p-pulse US images after laser activation.
Set module parameters for each module in the current run case's module sequence.
Access each module parameter by index corresponding to its order in the module sequence.
Set ExtLaser.QSdelay in external laser modules to the value of laser Q-switch delay tuned previously, in microseconds.
In ultrafast imaging module, set Resource.numFrame to 100.
Set SeqControl.PRI to 200 µs in ultrafast imaging module.
Set TW.polarity to 1 for P-pulse and -1 for N-pulse in ultrafast imaging module.
Acquire full aperture imaging window of 38.8 mm wide for number of frames in Resource.numFrame, pulse repetition interval of SeqControl.PRI.
Save data for off-line processing.

Set SeqControl.lastPRI_Module in idle module to the length of time between laser pulses (100 ms) subtracted by Q-switch delay, imaging data acquisition time (20 ms), and a 20 µs margin for the signal to travel.
